_comment: Keeper L1-vs-L2 divergence alert (Grafana unified alerting, file-provisioned shape).
Fires when keeper_route_divergent == 1 on any route: L1 curl failed while
L2 opencode CLI passed on the same route+run (the 'weird' case).
Plain down (both legs fail) does NOT page here by design.
DATASOURCE_UID: filled as grafanacloud-prom (Hosted Prometheus fed by
keeper-alloy; Cloud cannot scrape bearer-gated /metrics directly).
CONTACT: `notifications` stays empty until the owner picks a receiver;
attach the contact point uid here before apply (owner-only step).

rules.title: Keeper route divergent (curl fails, opencode CLI passes)

annotations.description: Direct HTTP probing failed but the opencode CLI leg passed on the same route+run. Credential or policy anomaly, not an outage. Matrix: https://keeper.pkubelka.cz/ ; runbook: docs/cutover-rehearsal-2026-09-18.md
